quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Smart Home Security] Many homeowners are now installing smart security cameras that send alerts directly to their phones. Because the cameras use motion detection, they can tell the difference between a person walking by and a passing car. This helps reduce the number of false alarms compared to older systems.
quests.question: Why do the new cameras cause fewer false alarms?
options: They can tell the difference between people and cars
They only turn on at night
They record in higher resolution
They connect directly to the police
quests.correctAnswer: They can tell the difference between people and cars
quests.hint: The reason relates to what the motion detection feature can recognize.
quests.explanation: The passage explains that motion detection lets the cameras distinguish people from passing cars, which cuts down on false alarms.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Simple Breathing Technique] When Wei feels stressed at work, she pauses for two minutes and practices slow, deep breathing. Although the technique seems simple, studies show it can lower heart rate and ease tension almost immediately. Wei now uses it before every important meeting.
quests.question: What does Wei do before every important meeting?
options: Practices slow, deep breathing
Takes a short walk outside
Drinks a cup of coffee
Reviews her notes twice
quests.correctAnswer: Practices slow, deep breathing
quests.hint: Look at the habit described in the first sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage states that Wei practices slow, deep breathing to manage stress before meetings.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Tracking Freelance Income] Freelancers often struggle to track irregular income because payments arrive at different times each month. To solve this, Tariq now records every payment in a spreadsheet as soon as it arrives, which makes it much easier to plan his monthly budget.
quests.question: Why does Tariq record payments as soon as they arrive?
options: It helps him find new clients
It is required by law
It increases his hourly rate
It makes budgeting easier
quests.correctAnswer: It makes budgeting easier
quests.hint: The benefit is stated at the end of the passage.
quests.explanation: The passage says recording payments right away makes it easier for Tariq to plan his budget.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Visa Application] Before traveling abroad for work, Hana had to apply for a business visa, which required a letter from her employer and proof of her return flight. Although the process usually takes two weeks, hers was approved in just five days.
quests.question: How long did it usually take to get approved, according to the passage?
options: Five days
One month
Two weeks
Three days
quests.correctAnswer: Two weeks
quests.hint: Distinguish the usual time from how long Hana's actually took.
quests.explanation: The passage says the process usually takes two weeks, though Hana's was faster.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Protecting Sea Turtles] Sea turtle populations have declined for decades because of ocean pollution and the loss of nesting beaches. Conservation groups now protect nesting sites with fences and volunteers, which has helped some turtle populations slowly begin to recover.
quests.question: How are conservation groups helping sea turtle populations recover?
options: By protecting nesting sites with fences and volunteers
By breeding turtles in laboratories
By banning all beach visitors
By moving turtles to aquariums
quests.correctAnswer: By protecting nesting sites with fences and volunteers
quests.hint: The specific protection method is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage explains that fencing off nesting sites and using volunteers has helped turtle numbers recover.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Food Allergy Labels] A new law now requires food companies to clearly list the top nine allergens on every product label. Supporters say the change will make grocery shopping much safer for people with severe allergies, since ingredients will no longer be hidden in long lists.
quests.question: What do supporters say about the new labeling law?
options: It will make food more expensive
It will slow down production
It will make grocery shopping safer
It will reduce food variety
quests.correctAnswer: It will make grocery shopping safer
quests.hint: The supporters' opinion is stated in the second sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says supporters believe the law will make shopping safer for people with allergies.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [An Online Learning Platform] The new online platform lets students learn at their own pace instead of following a fixed class schedule. Because lessons are recorded, learners can pause, rewind, and review difficult sections as many times as they need before moving forward.
quests.question: What advantage does the platform offer because lessons are recorded?
options: Learners must finish lessons within a day
Learners cannot skip any section
Learners can pause and review sections as needed
Learners receive grades automatically
quests.correctAnswer: Learners can pause and review sections as needed
quests.hint: The benefit connected to recorded lessons is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says recorded lessons let learners pause, rewind, and review as many times as needed.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A History Podcast] Each week, the podcast 'Forgotten Voices' explores a lesser-known event from world history through interviews with historians. The host says she chose the topic because textbooks often skip smaller stories that still shaped major events.
quests.question: Why did the host choose this podcast topic?
options: Textbooks often skip smaller stories that shaped history
She wanted to interview famous actors
She studied history in college
Listeners requested more recent events
quests.correctAnswer: Textbooks often skip smaller stories that shaped history
quests.hint: Her reason is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the host chose the topic because textbooks often overlook smaller but important stories.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Library Maker Space] The public library recently opened a maker space with 3D printers and sewing machines that anyone with a library card can use for free. Staff say the goal is to give community members access to tools they might not otherwise be able to afford.
quests.question: What is the library's goal for the maker space?
options: To sell handmade items for profit
To give the community access to tools they cannot afford
To train future engineers only
To replace the library's book collection
quests.correctAnswer: To give the community access to tools they cannot afford
quests.hint: The stated goal is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the library wants to give community members access to tools they might not afford otherwise.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Multigenerational Household] When Priya's parents moved in with her family last year, they converted the garage into a small apartment. Although the transition took some adjustment, Priya says having her parents nearby has made childcare much easier for her and her husband.
quests.question: How has the living arrangement helped Priya and her husband?
options: It has lowered their monthly rent
It has made childcare much easier
It has given them more privacy
It has reduced their commute time
quests.correctAnswer: It has made childcare much easier
quests.hint: The benefit is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says having her parents nearby has made childcare easier for Priya and her husband.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Noise-Cancelling Headphones] Since buying noise-cancelling headphones, Tomás finds it much easier to concentrate in his open-plan office. The headphones block out nearby conversations and keyboard noise, allowing him to focus on his work without interruption.
quests.question: What do the headphones block out, according to the passage?
options: Only loud phone calls
Music playing in the office
Air conditioning sounds
Nearby conversations and keyboard noise
quests.correctAnswer: Nearby conversations and keyboard noise
quests.hint: The specific sounds blocked are listed in the second sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the headphones block out nearby conversations and keyboard noise.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Hydration During Exercise] Trainers recommend drinking water before, during, and after exercise, even if you do not feel thirsty. This is because thirst is not always a reliable signal, and by the time you feel thirsty, your body may already be mildly dehydrated.
quests.question: Why do trainers say thirst is not a reliable signal?
options: The body may already be dehydrated by the time you feel thirsty
Thirst only happens after exercise ends
Thirst means you have had too much water
Thirst is the same as hunger
quests.correctAnswer: The body may already be dehydrated by the time you feel thirsty
quests.hint: The explanation follows directly after the claim about thirst.
quests.explanation: The passage explains that by the time thirst is felt, the body may already be mildly dehydrated.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Performance Review] During her performance review, Ingrid's manager praised her communication skills but suggested she delegate more tasks to her team. Ingrid appreciated the honest feedback and decided to set clearer weekly goals for her team members.
quests.question: What did Ingrid's manager suggest she improve?
options: Her communication skills
Her attendance record
Delegating more tasks to her team
Her technical knowledge
quests.correctAnswer: Delegating more tasks to her team
quests.hint: Distinguish what was praised from what was suggested as an improvement.
quests.explanation: The passage says the manager suggested Ingrid delegate more tasks, while praising her communication.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Packing Light] Experienced travelers often recommend packing clothes that can be mixed and matched, rather than bringing a separate outfit for every day. This approach not only saves space in the suitcase but also makes it easier to move quickly through busy airports.
quests.question: What is one benefit of packing mix-and-match clothes?
options: It guarantees cheaper flights
It makes moving through airports easier
It avoids the need for luggage tags
It prevents lost luggage
quests.correctAnswer: It makes moving through airports easier
quests.hint: The benefit is stated at the end of the passage, alongside space-saving.
quests.explanation: The passage says packing this way saves space and makes moving through airports easier.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Comparing Online Reviews] Before buying anything online, Devon always reads at least ten customer reviews, paying close attention to complaints rather than praise. He believes negative reviews reveal problems that product descriptions rarely mention.
quests.question: Why does Devon focus on negative reviews?
options: They are usually written by experts
They reveal problems descriptions rarely mention
They are always more detailed
They help him get discounts
quests.correctAnswer: They reveal problems descriptions rarely mention
quests.hint: His reasoning is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says Devon believes negative reviews reveal problems that product descriptions rarely mention.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Urban Community Gardens] The city has converted several empty lots into community gardens where residents can rent a small plot to grow vegetables. Demand has been so high that new applicants are now placed on a waiting list that can take up to a year.
quests.question: What happens to new applicants for a garden plot?
options: They are given a smaller plot
They must share with another family
They are asked to pay extra
They are placed on a waiting list
quests.correctAnswer: They are placed on a waiting list
quests.hint: The outcome for new applicants is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says new applicants are placed on a waiting list because of high demand.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Documentary Premiere] The environmental documentary 'Silent Reef' premieres this Friday at the downtown cinema, followed by a discussion with the director. Tickets include a donation to a coral restoration charity, and organizers expect the event to sell out.
quests.question: What does the ticket price include, besides admission?
options: A signed poster from the director
A donation to a coral restoration charity
A free copy of the film
Dinner with the film crew
quests.correctAnswer: A donation to a coral restoration charity
quests.hint: Look at what the tickets support, mentioned in the second sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says ticket prices include a donation to a coral restoration charity.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Debate Club Competition] At this year's regional debate competition, students had only fifteen minutes to prepare arguments on topics they had never seen before. Despite the short preparation time, the school's team advanced to the final round for the first time in its history.
quests.question: What made this year's competition especially challenging?
options: The competition lasted an entire week
Teams had to debate in a foreign language
Judges changed the rules midway through
Students had only fifteen minutes to prepare on unseen topics
quests.correctAnswer: Students had only fifteen minutes to prepare on unseen topics
quests.hint: The challenge is described in the first sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage explains that students had just fifteen minutes to prepare arguments on unfamiliar topics.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Sleep Tracking Apps] Sleep tracking apps use a phone's motion sensor to estimate how long a person spends in light and deep sleep. Although the results are not always perfectly accurate, many users say the app has helped them notice patterns, such as how caffeine affects their rest.
quests.question: What have many users noticed by using the app, according to the passage?
options: Their exact heart rate at all times
Patterns such as how caffeine affects their rest
The best time to exercise
How much they should eat
quests.correctAnswer: Patterns such as how caffeine affects their rest
quests.hint: The example given is at the end of the passage.
quests.explanation: The passage says users have noticed patterns, including how caffeine affects their sleep.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Electric Car Charging Stations] The city plans to add fifty new electric car charging stations by next year, mostly near shopping centers and train stations. Officials hope the convenient locations will encourage more residents to switch from gasoline vehicles.
quests.question: Where will most of the new charging stations be located?
options: Only in residential neighborhoods
Near shopping centers and train stations
Along the highway only
Next to government buildings
quests.correctAnswer: Near shopping centers and train stations
quests.hint: The locations are named in the first sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the stations will mostly be near shopping centers and train stations.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Co-Parenting Schedule] After their divorce, Malik and his ex-wife created a shared calendar so their children's activities would never be double-booked. Although the arrangement took time to adjust to, both parents say clear communication has made co-parenting far less stressful.
quests.question: What has made co-parenting less stressful for Malik and his ex-wife?
options: Living in the same house
Hiring a full-time babysitter
Reducing the children's activities
Clear communication
quests.correctAnswer: Clear communication
quests.hint: The key factor is named in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says clear communication has made co-parenting far less stressful for both parents.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Workplace Mentorship Program] The company recently launched a mentorship program pairing new employees with experienced staff for their first six months. Early feedback suggests that new hires who participate feel more confident and are less likely to leave within the first year.
quests.question: What does early feedback suggest about the mentorship program?
options: Participants receive higher starting salaries
Participants are promoted faster than others
Participants feel more confident and stay longer
Participants work fewer hours
quests.correctAnswer: Participants feel more confident and stay longer
quests.hint: The reported effect is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says feedback shows participants feel more confident and are less likely to leave early.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Public Art Mural] Local artists were invited to submit designs for a mural celebrating the city's history, and the winning design will cover an entire wall of the train station. The project is funded entirely by donations from local businesses.
quests.question: How is the mural project being funded?
options: Entirely by donations from local businesses
By a national art grant
By ticket sales at the station
By a small tax increase
quests.correctAnswer: Entirely by donations from local businesses
quests.hint: The funding source is stated in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the project is funded entirely by donations from local businesses.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Currency Exchange Tips] Travel experts often advise exchanging only a small amount of money at the airport, since airport exchange rates are usually the worst available. Instead, they recommend withdrawing cash from a local ATM after arriving, which typically offers a better rate.
quests.question: What do travel experts recommend instead of exchanging money at the airport?
options: Exchanging money before the trip begins
Using only credit cards abroad
Asking a hotel to exchange currency
Withdrawing cash from a local ATM after arriving
quests.correctAnswer: Withdrawing cash from a local ATM after arriving
quests.hint: The alternative suggestion is given in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says experts recommend withdrawing cash from a local ATM instead of exchanging at the airport.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Meal Prepping] Every Sunday, Aisha spends two hours preparing meals for the entire work week, storing them in labeled containers in the fridge. She says this habit has saved her both money and time, since she rarely orders takeout anymore.
quests.question: What has meal prepping saved Aisha, according to the passage?
options: Money and time
Only time, not money
Only money, not time
Neither money nor time
quests.correctAnswer: Money and time
quests.hint: Look at the two things mentioned right after 'saved her'.
quests.explanation: The passage says meal prepping has saved Aisha both money and time.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Coding Bootcamp] The twelve-week coding bootcamp promises to prepare beginners for entry-level programming jobs, though it requires roughly forty hours of study per week. Graduates say the intense pace was difficult, but most found jobs within three months of finishing.
quests.question: How did most graduates do after finishing the bootcamp?
options: They needed a second bootcamp
They struggled to find any job
They found jobs within three months
They returned to their old careers
quests.correctAnswer: They found jobs within three months
quests.hint: The outcome for most graduates is stated in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says most graduates found jobs within three months of completing the bootcamp.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Reducing Plastic Packaging] Several grocery chains have started removing plastic wrap from fruits and vegetables, replacing it with reusable mesh bags or no packaging at all. The change is expected to reduce plastic waste significantly, although a few customers have complained about produce spoiling faster.
quests.question: What complaint have some customers had about the change?
options: Prices have gone up
Fewer fruits are available
Produce spoils faster
Bags are hard to carry
quests.correctAnswer: Produce spoils faster
quests.hint: The complaint is mentioned at the very end of the passage.
quests.explanation: The passage says some customers have complained that produce spoils faster without the plastic wrap.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Local Film Festival] This year's independent film festival received a record number of submissions, forcing organizers to add a second screening venue downtown. Filmmakers say the festival's growing reputation has made it an important stop for reaching new audiences before wider release.
quests.question: Why did organizers add a second screening venue?
options: The first venue was under repair
Ticket prices needed to be lowered
A sponsor requested a larger event
They received a record number of submissions
quests.correctAnswer: They received a record number of submissions
quests.hint: The reason is explained in the first sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says a record number of submissions led organizers to add a second venue.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Company Wellness Program] To reduce employee burnout, the company introduced a wellness program offering free gym memberships and two extra mental health days per year. A survey taken six months later showed that reported stress levels among staff had noticeably decreased.
quests.question: What did the survey show six months after the program began?
options: Employees wanted more vacation days instead
Reported stress levels had noticeably decreased
Gym memberships were rarely used
Stress levels had stayed the same
quests.correctAnswer: Reported stress levels had noticeably decreased
quests.hint: The survey result is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the survey found that reported stress levels had noticeably decreased.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Password Manager App] Security experts recommend using a password manager instead of reusing the same password across multiple accounts. The app stores encrypted passwords and can generate a unique, complex password for every website, which greatly reduces the risk if one account is ever compromised.
quests.question: Why does using a password manager reduce risk, according to the passage?
options: It removes the need for any password
It blocks all hacking attempts
It generates a unique password for every website
It shares passwords safely with friends
quests.correctAnswer: It generates a unique password for every website
quests.hint: The reason is explained in the second half of the passage.
quests.explanation: The passage explains that generating a unique password for each site reduces risk if one account is compromised.
